blocks.en: A symmetric operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is said to be \textbf{essentially self-adjoint} if its closure is self-adjoint. If $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is closed, a subset $D\subset\mathcal{D}(A)$ of the domain is called a \textbf{core} of the operator if $\overline{(D,A)}=(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$; i.e., the closure of the restriction of the operator to $D$ is the original operator.
blocks.zh: 若对称算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的闭包是自伴随的, 则称它是\textbf{本质自伴随的}. 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是闭的, 则定义域的子集 $D\subset\mathcal{D}(A)$ 在满足 $\overline{(D,A)}=(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 时称为该算子的一个\textbf{核}; 即算子在 $D$ 上的限制的闭包为原算子.
blocks.label: def:essential-self-adjointness-and-core

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The easiest test for essential self-adjointness involves quantities called the deficiency indices.
blocks.zh: 本质自伴随性的最简单判别方法涉及称为亏指数的量.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a densely defined operator from $H$ to $H$, and let $\gamma^+$ be the dimension of $\mathcal{R}(A-iI)^\perp$ and $\gamma^-$ the dimension of $\mathcal{R}(A+iI)^\perp$. The numbers $(\gamma^+,\gamma^-)$ are called the \textbf{deficiency indices} of the operator.
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为从 $H$ 到 $H$ 的稠密定义算子, 令 $\gamma^+$ 为 $\mathcal{R}(A-iI)^\perp$ 的维数, $\gamma^-$ 为 $\mathcal{R}(A+iI)^\perp$ 的维数. 数对 $(\gamma^+,\gamma^-)$ 称为该算子的\textbf{亏指数}.
blocks.label: def:operator-deficiency-indices

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: An operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is essentially self-adjoint if and only if its deficiency indices are both $0$.
blocks.zh: 算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是本质自伴随的, 当且仅当它的两个亏指数均为 $0$.
blocks.label: thm:essential-self-adjointness-zero-deficiency

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof is left to the reader (Problem~\ref{ex:essential-self-adjointness-deficiency-proof}).

blocks.en: We can gain some understanding of the spectrum of an operator by studying its adjoint. Our first result relates the compression spectrum of an operator to the point spectrum of its Hilbert adjoint.
blocks.zh: 通过研究算子的伴随, 可以对其谱有所了解. 第一个结果将算子的压缩谱与其 Hilbert 伴随的点谱联系起来.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a densely defined operator from $H$ to $H$. A complex number $\lambda$ has deficiency $m$ if and only if $\overline\lambda$ is an eigenvalue of $A^*$ with multiplicity $m$.
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为从 $H$ 到 $H$ 的稠密定义算子. 复数 $\lambda$ 的亏数为 $m$, 当且仅当 $\overline\lambda$ 是 $A^*$ 的重数为 $m$ 的特征值.
blocks.label: thm:adjoint-deficiency-conjugate-eigenvalue

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
The proof of this is a simple application of Theorem~\ref{thm:range-complement-adjoint-nullspace} and is left to the reader (Problem~\ref{ex:adjoint-deficiency-eigenvalue-proof}).

We can say a great deal about the spectrum of symmetric operators.
blocks.zh:
其证明是 Theorem~\ref{thm:range-complement-adjoint-nullspace} 的简单应用, 留给读者 (Problem~\ref{ex:adjoint-deficiency-eigenvalue-proof}).

关于对称算子的谱, 可以得到许多结论.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a densely defined operator from $H$ to $H$. If $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is symmetric, then:\begin{enumerate}\item $(Ax,x)$ is real for every $x\in\mathcal{D}(A)$.\item All eigenvalues of $A$ are real.\item Eigenvectors of $A$ corresponding to distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal.\item The continuous spectrum of $A$ is real.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为从 $H$ 到 $H$ 的稠密定义算子. 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是对称的, 则:\begin{enumerate}\item 对每个 $x\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, $(Ax,x)$ 都是实数.\item $A$ 的所有特征值都是实数.\item $A$ 的不同特征值所对应的特征向量彼此正交.\item $A$ 的连续谱是实的.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: thm:symmetric-operator-spectral-properties

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If an operator is self-adjoint, we can say even more.
blocks.zh: 若算子是自伴随的, 还能得到更多结论.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a densely defined operator from $H$ to $H$. If $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is self-adjoint, then every $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$ with nonzero imaginary part is in the resolvent set of $A$. Furthermore, the compression spectrum is empty.
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 为从 $H$ 到 $H$ 的稠密定义算子. 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是自伴随的, 则每个虚部非零的 $\lambda\in\mathbb{C}$ 都属于 $A$ 的预解集. 此外, 压缩谱为空集.
blocks.label: thm:self-adjoint-spectrum-real-no-compression

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We first note that Theorem~\ref{thm:symmetric-operator-spectral-properties} says that the continuous spectrum of $A$ is real and that all eigenvalues of $A$ are real. Next, Theorem~\ref{thm:adjoint-deficiency-conjugate-eigenvalue} says that if $\lambda$ has nonzero deficiency, then $\overline\lambda$ is an eigenvalue of $A(=A^*)$. Hence $\lambda$ must be real and must lie in the point spectrum rather than the compression spectrum.
blocks.zh: 首先注意, Theorem~\ref{thm:symmetric-operator-spectral-properties} 表明 $A$ 的连续谱是实的, 且 $A$ 的所有特征值都是实数. 其次, Theorem~\ref{thm:adjoint-deficiency-conjugate-eigenvalue} 表明, 若 $\lambda$ 的亏数非零, 则 $\overline\lambda$ 是 $A(=A^*)$ 的特征值. 因而 $\lambda$ 必为实数, 且必属于点谱而非压缩谱.
